New GTA 6 details from The Guardian’s preview at Rockstar North:

- It’s the first title in the series to encourage empathy, as your actions will have some effect on how the game plays out
- You can rob high-end shops in a shopping mall
- A lot of devs have finished working on the game a month before release and are taking a well deserved rest after 10+ years of development
- Rockstar says they could’ve made GTA 5.5 and done it faster but that’s not what they wanted: “You have to take big swings. It can’t be just more of the same,” says Rob Nelson
- Rockstar says the game is really hard to close down because they always want to add more, but they reached the point where it needs to be finalized and released
- There are 62 types of birds you can record in a wildlife logbook and observe them through binoculars
- Every NPC you see has been designed by someone, even down to their clothes
- Tech limits are no longer the problem for Rockstar but it’s now the human resources and how much the team can build, simply throwing money at a game doesn’t guarantee it will be good

(via The Guardian / @GameRoll_)
